record.oneLiner: Accounting platform with a REST API (contacts, invoices, payments, bank transactions, payroll) and an official open-source MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Custom Connections use client-credentials OAuth with only a client ID and secret, but the FAQ calls them a premium option.
